title: Topic 14: Work & Study - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Talk about your job or studies

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Job advertisement format
JOB AT CAFE SOL!
We need one person for the morning: seven o'clock
to eleven o'clock, Monday to Friday.
You: you like people, you can speak a little English,
and you can help in the kitchen.
We pay ten dollars for one hour.
Write to: cafesol@mail.com

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Duca: Where is your sister now, Lia?
Lia:  At the office! She has a new job - she writes
      for a big company.
Duca: Nice! And you?
Lia:  I am a student. I study at night. In the morning
      I help at my father's shop.
Duca: Study AND work - you can do it all!

readingQuestions.question: What can the person do to answer this ad?
What are Duca and Lia talking about?
options: Work and study in Lia's family
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Work and study in Lia's family

options: She writes for a big company
